title: Chapter 156
text:
"Retreat and set up camp!" Lu Cheng took a deep look at Han Xiao and glanced at the refugees. He ordered his troops to set up camp in the distance.

The players were in an uproar. Some of the players who had not chosen the mission camp were observing. From the current situation, it seemed that Green Valley Town had a higher chance of winning.

The sky darkened.

Han Xiao came to Lu Cheng's camp. The guards saw Han Xiao approaching and raised their guns nervously.

"Relax, I'm going to talk to your leader," Han Xiao said.

The guards were still holding their guns, not daring to let Han Xiao enter the camp.

At this time, Lu Cheng heard the commotion and walked over. He said in a deep voice, "Let him in."

If Black Phantom wanted to kill him, there was no need to inform him. It seemed that Black Phantom had other intentions. Lu Cheng asked the guards to back off and led the way into the camp that had just been set up. Behind Han Xiao were Mad Blade and Angry Sword.

Lu Cheng sat down casually. He was not worried that Han Xiao would threaten his life. He crossed his hands and held his chin. He said in a deep voice, "The famous Black Phantom appeared in such a small place. I don't know why you intervened. Balsas should not be qualified to hire an assassin of your level. Why are you visiting me?"

Han Xiao went straight to the point. "I'm here to help you."

"Help me?" Lu Cheng was confused. "We've never met before."

Han Xiao casually made up a reason. "I think you're more pleasing to the eye than Balsas."

Lu Cheng felt strange. He paused for a moment before saying, "Balsas … He's a despicable guy. He used the refugees as cannon fodder. I really don't understand why these refugees don't even care about their lives. What benefits did Balsas give them? Could it be that he took their families hostage? I gave them a way out, but they didn't want to leave. "

"They don't have much combat power. Why don't you just crush them? With your armed forces, it'll be a one-sided massacre." Han Xiao smiled.

Lu Cheng was expressionless. He did not comment on this topic. He changed the topic. "Black Phantom, I don't know you, and I don't know why you're helping me. What are you going to do? Assassinate Balsas? I believe it'll be easy for you. "

"No, I don't want to kill anyone," Han Xiao said perfunctorily.

Lu Cheng's mouth twitched. An assassin said that he didn't want to kill anyone? This was even more ridiculous than the Navy saying they couldn't swim!

"Then how do you want to help me?"

"If you care about the refugees, I can help you solve it."

Lu Cheng raised an eyebrow. "You have a way to convince them?"

"Perhaps."

"… Then what do you want from me?"

Lu Cheng did not think that an unknown legendary assassin would help him for free. There must be a motive, but he did not understand what Black Phantom saw in him.

"I don't need payment."

Lu Cheng's eyes darkened as he stared into Han Xiao's eyes. However, all he saw was an unfathomable fog. He couldn't see through what Han Xiao was thinking. Generally speaking, if one didn't want a reward, it meant that one had ulterior motives and was even more ambitious.

Silence.

On the other side, Mad Blade was confused, but it did not stop him from noticing that the atmosphere had become stiff, and the back of his neck was a little tight.

After two minutes of stalemate, Lu Cheng did not say anything in the end. He nodded and slowly said, "Then I'll leave it to you."

…

Walking out of Lu Cheng's tent, Han Xiao patted Mad Blade's shoulder and said, "I have something for you to do."

"You have triggered the mission [Spread the News]."

The mission requirement was to spread the news that Black Phantom had joined Lu Cheng's camp. The reward would be based on evaluation. The more people who knew the news, the more experience he would get. Players were actually counted in the number of people. Mad Blade did not suspect anything and went to Green Valley Town to spread the news.

Maybe normal players would be surprised to see such a realistic and interactive mission for the first time, but Mad Blade had been baptized by Han Xiao's love, so he was not surprised by any kind of mission.

Now it will depend on how much influence I have now, Han Xiao thought to himself.

Mad Blade was very efficient, and it was also because of his small fame. The news spread quickly among the players in Green Valley Town. The players were in an uproar.

"If we choose Green Valley Town, will we become enemies with Black Phantom?"

"How can we beat him!"

"Is this a mission guide?"

The players were panicking. The scene of Han Xiao killing the beasts during the day was still deeply engraved in their minds. Becoming enemies with Black Phantom was simply asking for death. The situation of the mission was reversed, and the chances of winning in Green Valley Town fell to the bottom.

Also, if they chose to defend Green Valley Town, they would have to attack Black Phantom, which would cause their favorability to drop. It was a waste to offend him for a small mission. If they really fought, should they attack him or not? If they did not attack, how would they defend Green Valley Town? This was a dead end.

The players who chose Green Valley Town were depressed. They felt that they had no chance of winning. If they wanted to complete the mission, they could only join Lu Cheng's camp, but they could not choose another camp.

Pork Bun Beat Dog was very decisive. He was the first to go to Lu Cheng's camp. The mission was secondary, and the main reason was to film more Han Xiao's material.

The guards had already received Lu Cheng's order and let the refugees go. Pork Bun Beat Dog successfully joined Lu Cheng's camp. Han Xiao, who was observing from the side, squinted his eyes and noticed Pork Bun Beat Dog.

"This ID is a bit familiar … Isn't this a video host?" Han Xiao remembered Pork Bun Beat Dog's ID. In his previous life, he was a very famous video host. He had made many episodes of the Galaxy series and was very popular.

At this moment, Han Technician suddenly had a new idea … Eh, why did he say 'again'?

Han Xiao walked out and came in front of Pork Bun Beat Dog.

"Your choice is very wise. I think you have potential. Do you want to be my assistant temporarily?" Han Xiao said.

Pork Bun Beat Dog's eyes widened. He was stunned. Did he trigger a hidden mission?

He had never had such high hopes, but he did not expect to meet it!

Is this life? You can't ask for what you want, but what you don't want is given to you. Pork Bun Beat Dog was stunned.

The surrounding players were in an uproar.

"He triggered Black Phantom's hidden mission!"

"How did he do it?"

"Is it possible to just join Black Phantom's side?"

"This mission is actually a chance to trigger the hidden mission?"

Realizing this, the players who were still watching eagerly joined Lu Cheng's side. They could not wait. Like a refugee tide, the camp was full of players. It was crowded and crowded. The guards were shocked and did not know if they should chase them away.

The players who had chosen their side hurriedly found Han Xiao, wanting to trigger the hidden mission. However, they were all rejected.

"Why not?"

"Could it be that only the first person to join the camp can trigger the hidden mission?"

This was the most likely guess. The players who were one step slower wanted to knock their heads on the ground. They felt like they had bought a lottery ticket and were notified that they had won five million, only to be called three minutes later to say that they had called the wrong number.

They originally had the opportunity to be the first person to try, but this opportunity was taken away by Pork Bun Beat Dog.

He was a step too slow and missed a good opportunity!

The players thumped their chests and stamped their feet.

Han Xiao brought the excited Pork Bun Beat Dog to one side and increased his favorability by five points. He secretly planned how to make use of Pork Bun Beat Dog.

Bringing a player who made video games was like bringing a reporter with him. He would have a channel to freely pass information to the players. Selectively giving the players some information and only telling the players what he wanted them to know was very beneficial to him.

After experiencing the baptism of information explosion, controlling public opinion was like having a weapon in hand. It could discredit the opponent, guide the public opinion, and help to shape his own image. There were too many examples. The news broadcast was like this …

"Seems like I'm playing more and more high-end games." Han Xiao was very happy. He wrote a follow mission with a generous reward and threw it to Pork Bun Beat Dog. Then, he took out a phone that could be used to contact him and handed it to Pork Bun Beat Dog. He reminded him not to lose it. Pork Bun Beat Dog nodded and kept the phone solemnly.

Now, there were two players following him, Pork Bun and Mad Blade. Han Xiao's mission quota was enough. After the second evolution, the quota for each level increased from three hundred to five hundred. In other words, when he was at level 40, the amount increased to twelve thousand. Now, it had doubled to twenty-five thousand. In total, the total amount was fifty thousand. The amount of rewards he could give to the players had increased.

Han Xiao did not have any news to spread for the time being. He first gave Pork Bun the contact number. There would be a time when it would be useful in the future.

"Now, I have three players in mind, Mad Blade, Maple Moon, and Pork Bun. The number is a little small. I need to expand the backup team." Han Xiao's vision was higher. He would rather go without than have something substandard. His quota was destined to be an elite. If he could absorb the top few experts in the China region into his team, then it would be too profitable. However, Han Technician felt that this possibility was slim. Those super experts all had their own personalities.
